name: No privileged containers
description: Fail workloads that run privileged containers or add the SYS_ADMIN capability.
long_description: ISM-1246 (partial): Findings show selected Kubernetes workload hardening settings; they do not prove that all ASD and vendor guidance was identified, reconciled or implemented. ISM-1490 (partial): Scan and PolicyReport results show workload image and execution guardrails on Kubernetes servers; they do not prove host or endpoint application control. ISM-1604 (partial): Findings show selected container isolation and workload hardening settings; they do not assess the Kubernetes control plane, node runtime configuration or every administrative interface used to manage the isolation mechanism. ISM-1657 (partial): Approved-image and workload-execution findings evidence the Kubernetes translation of application control; they do not inspect binaries inside images. ISM-1871 (partial): Cluster-wide workload findings show whether the Kubernetes translation is applied across scanned namespaces; they do not assess host filesystem locations.
remediation: Remove privileged mode and drop SYS_ADMIN unless it is explicitly required.

provenance.rationale: The local rule follows the upstream privileged and SYS_ADMIN checks and adds standalone fixtures for regular and init containers.
